title: Stop agents not in policy/abp.json from committing to SovereignWebsite__IaC: remove the reach now, and decide on required checks
why: Asked by Dinis in b.conductor's session after elevenlabs.b and soundcloud.b were started with IaC attached. Today nothing prevents a push to IaC's dev: no hook, a pre-approved push in .claude/settings.json, and a dev ruleset without required checks. Only the Checks run detects it, after the push.
checks: read-only review of IaC dev: policy/abp.json, build/abp.mjs, .github/workflows/checks.yml, build/org-apply.mjs, .claude/settings.json
the four commits verified: team/keys.json only
options: a) Remove the reach: no new agent session gets IaC attached (keys published in its own site/keys/); an ABP hook in IaC blocks writes outside team/keys.json by agents not in policy/abp.json and replaces the pre-approved push
b) a) plus a required status check (Checks) on dev-safe, so IaC changes go through pull requests or a merge queue
c) Keep detection only; a red Checks run raises a HOLD
recommendation: a) now; b) when Dinis is ready for pull requests on IaC
